up: Retrieve all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1240409. For each molecule, return the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Sort the results by the ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH doc_molecules AS (SELECT DISTINCT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.doc_id = (SELECT d.doc_id FROM docs d WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1240409')) SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM doc_molecules dm JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id
